digest: Coverage centred on Max Verstappen's victory in a record-breaking race of 352 overtakes and 35 lead changes, with Jolyon Palmer praising his fight with George Russell and Juan Pablo Montoya explaining how Red Bull outsmarted Mercedes (Motorsport.com). Unaired radio revealed Red Bull considered giving up Verstappen's lead, while Isack Hadjar was frustrated (Motorsport.com). Ferrari's second Leclerc–Hamilton collision in three races prompted questions over their partnership (BBC Sport), and Arvid Lindblad remained puzzled by the spin that ended his race (RaceFans).
